verdict.rationale: Snyk documents an official local MCP Server (shipped via Snyk CLI) for connecting coding agents/ADEs, with setup and validation instructions, and an independent probe confirms the MCP handshake works (JSON-RPC initialize returns serverInfo/capabilities). This is corroborated first-party documentation plus hands-on verification. Missing for 10: no independent third-party (non-vendor) review of the MCP integration's real-world reliability in agent workflows.
